question: Which mega couple just got married at Madison Square Garden?
story: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce reportedly got married inside Madison Square Garden, and Adam Sandler was the one who married them. Yes, that Adam Sandler. According to reporting from outlets like CNN and CBS News, the pop superstar and the Kansas City Chiefs tight end tied the knot on July third in front of a guest list that reads like an awards show. Selena Gomez, Ed Sheeran, Blake Lively, Steven Spielberg, and Tom Brady were all reportedly there. Sources say there was no wedding party. Taylor picked her brother as man of honor, and Travis picked his brother Jason as best man. The couple apparently transformed the arena into a secret garden, with giant photos of the two of them at every age lining the walls. And in the middle of all that glamour, they reportedly donated twenty six million dollars to charity. Blank Space walked so this wedding could run.
